text.en: 6th. SEPTEMBER, 2021 No. S 24 LAND CODE {AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2016 {S 37/2016) Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section 1 of the Land Code {Amendment) Order, 2016, the Minister of Development, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 1st. January, 2021 as the date of commencement for the provisions of that Order as set out in the Schedule heretoSCHEDULE PROVISIONS OF LAND CODE {AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2016 section 5 {excluding section 47) section 6 section 7. Dated lllis 9th. day of Jamadilawal, 1442 Hijrial1 corresponding to the 24th. day of December, 2020. DATO SERI SETIA JR. AWANG HAJI SUHAIMI BIN HAJJ GAFAR Minister of Development.
